quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the exciting day a class travels somewhere new to learn!
quests.question: Field Trip
quests.hint: On this special day, the whole class travels somewhere new together.
quests.explanation: Yes! A field trip is a special day when the class visits a new place to learn.
quests.funFact: A field trip can take a whole class to a zoo, farm, or museum in one day!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the subject where we practice putting letters in order!
quests.question: Spelling
quests.hint: This subject is all about putting letters in the correct order.
quests.explanation: Yes! Spelling is the subject where we practice putting letters in the right order.
quests.funFact: Practicing a new word a few times can help you remember how to spell it!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the short break when we eat a small, healthy snack!
quests.question: Snack Time
quests.hint: This is a short break, smaller than lunchtime, for a quick bite.
quests.explanation: Yes! Snack time is the short break when we enjoy a small, healthy bite.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make popular, healthy choices for snack time!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the cozy time when our teacher reads us a story!
quests.question: Story Time
quests.hint: This is a cozy moment when everyone listens quietly to a story.
quests.explanation: Yes! Story time is when our teacher reads us a favorite tale aloud.
quests.funFact: Listening to stories can introduce you to brand new words you've never heard before!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the subject where we explore plants, animals, and how things work!
quests.question: Science
quests.hint: This subject is full of experiments and questions about the world.
quests.explanation: Yes! Science is the subject where we explore plants, animals, and how things work.
quests.funFact: Scientists ask questions and test ideas, just like students do in science class!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the time we sit together in a circle to share!
quests.question: Circle Time
quests.hint: Everyone sits together in a round shape for this special time.
quests.explanation: Yes! Circle time is when the whole class sits together in a circle to share.
quests.funFact: Sitting in a circle lets every student see each other's friendly faces!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the moment the whole class gathers close to talk!
quests.question: Circle Time
quests.hint: This often happens in the morning before lessons begin.
quests.explanation: That's right! We gather close together to talk and share during circle time.
quests.funFact: Sitting in a circle lets every student see each other's friendly faces!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the special day students ride together to visit a new place!
quests.question: Field Trip
quests.hint: You might ride a bus to a museum, farm, or zoo on this day.
quests.explanation: That's right! We travel together on a field trip to learn outside of school.
quests.funFact: A field trip can take a whole class to a zoo, farm, or museum in one day!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the special time we sit and listen to a tale!
quests.question: Story Time
quests.hint: Your teacher often reads a picture book aloud during this time.
quests.explanation: That's right! We sit together and listen closely during story time.
quests.funFact: Listening to stories can introduce you to brand new words you've never heard before!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the class where we do fun experiments and ask questions!
quests.question: Science
quests.hint: You might learn about plants, animals, or weather during this class.
quests.explanation: That's right! We ask questions and try experiments during science class.
quests.funFact: Scientists ask questions and test ideas, just like students do in science class!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the class where we learn how to spell new words!
quests.question: Spelling
quests.hint: You practice new words each week during this subject.
quests.explanation: That's right! We learn new words to spell correctly during spelling class.
quests.funFact: Practicing a new word a few times can help you remember how to spell it!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the quick moment we enjoy a treat between lessons!
quests.question: Snack Time
quests.hint: You might eat crackers, fruit, or a small treat during this time.
quests.explanation: That's right! We eat a little snack to keep our energy up during class.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make popular, healthy choices for snack time!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the fun day of learning outside the regular classroom!
quests.question: Field Trip
quests.hint: On this special day, the whole class travels somewhere new together.
quests.explanation: Well done! A field trip lets students explore and learn in a brand new place.
quests.funFact: A field trip can take a whole class to a zoo, farm, or museum in one day!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the moment we gather to hear a favorite book read aloud!
quests.question: Story Time
quests.hint: This is a cozy moment when everyone listens quietly to a story.
quests.explanation: Well done! Story time lets the whole class enjoy a book together.
quests.funFact: Listening to stories can introduce you to brand new words you've never heard before!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the subject that helps us learn about the natural world!
quests.question: Science
quests.hint: This subject is full of experiments and questions about the world.
quests.explanation: Well done! Science helps us understand the amazing world around us.
quests.funFact: Scientists ask questions and test ideas, just like students do in science class!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the friendly time we sit in a circle each morning!
quests.question: Circle Time
quests.hint: Everyone sits together in a round shape for this special time.
quests.explanation: Well done! Circle time helps every student feel like part of the class.
quests.funFact: Sitting in a circle lets every student see each other's friendly faces!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the little break spent munching on a healthy bite!
quests.question: Snack Time
quests.hint: This is a short break, smaller than lunchtime, for a quick bite.
quests.explanation: Well done! Snack time gives students a quick, tasty break between lessons.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make popular, healthy choices for snack time!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the subject that helps us write words correctly!
quests.question: Spelling
quests.hint: This subject is all about putting letters in the correct order.
quests.explanation: Well done! Spelling helps us write words the correct way every time.
quests.funFact: Practicing a new word a few times can help you remember how to spell it!

quests.instruction: Touch the thing full of pages and pictures that we read every day!
quests.question: Book
quests.hint: It has a cover, and inside are many pages full of words.
quests.explanation: Yes! A book is full of pages we read for stories and learning.
quests.funFact: The very first books were written by hand, long before printing was invented!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the day the classroom trades its walls for the outside world!
quests.question: Field Trip
quests.hint: You might ride a bus to a museum, farm, or zoo on this day.
quests.explanation: Yes! A field trip is a special day when the class visits a new place to learn.
quests.funFact: A field trip can take a whole class to a zoo, farm, or museum in one day!

quests.instruction: Find the box we open at lunchtime to eat our sandwich or fruit!
quests.question: Lunchbox
quests.hint: You open it at lunchtime to find your sandwich or snack inside.
quests.explanation: Yes! A lunchbox carries our food safely to school until it's time to eat.
quests.funFact: Packing your own lunchbox can be a fun way to choose your favorite foods!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the person whose office helps run the whole school!
quests.question: Principal
quests.hint: This person leads the whole school, not just one classroom.
quests.explanation: Yes! A principal is the person who leads and takes care of the whole school.
quests.funFact: A principal often visits many classrooms in just one single school day!

quests.instruction: Touch the object with numbers around its edge and hands that move!
quests.question: Clock
quests.hint: It has a round face, numbers, and hands that slowly move.
quests.explanation: Yes! A clock shows us the time with numbers and moving hands.
quests.funFact: Clock hands have moved the same direction for hundreds of years, called clockwise!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the short break when students run and play games!
quests.question: Recess
quests.hint: You might swing, slide, or run with friends during this time.
quests.explanation: Well done! Recess gives every student a fun break from classroom lessons.
quests.funFact: Recess helps students feel refreshed and ready to learn again afterward!

quests.instruction: Touch the container we fill with water to drink during the school day!
quests.question: Water Bottle
quests.hint: It has a lid or cap that opens and closes tightly.
quests.explanation: Well done! A water bottle helps students stay cool and ready to learn.
quests.funFact: Drinking enough water can help your brain stay focused during class!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the big room where we run, jump, and play!
quests.question: Gym
quests.hint: This big indoor room has plenty of space for running and games.
quests.explanation: That's right! We exercise and play games together inside the gym.
quests.funFact: Many schools use their gym for both exercise class and special school events!

quests.instruction: Touch the chart with little boxes for each day of the month!
quests.question: Calendar
quests.hint: It has little boxes, one for each day of the month.
quests.explanation: Yes! A calendar shows the days, weeks, and months of the year.
quests.funFact: A calendar shows twelve months, and each month has its own number of days!

quests.instruction: Find the word for someone who sits in class and does homework!
quests.question: Student
quests.hint: This person carries a backpack and sits at a desk to learn.
quests.explanation: Yes! A student is a person who goes to school to learn new things.
quests.funFact: Being a good student means trying your best, even when something feels hard!

quests.instruction: Touch the roll we peel and stick to hold our art in place!
quests.question: Tape
quests.hint: It comes on a roll, and one side is very sticky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Tape is the sticky roll we use to join paper together.
quests.funFact: Sticky tape lets people join paper together without any glue mess!

quests.instruction: Point to the soft, waxy stick children use most for coloring!
quests.question: Crayon
quests.hint: It can melt if it gets too warm in the sun.
quests.explanation: Correct! A crayon colors a picture, while a pencil is better for writing words.
quests.funFact: Crayons are made from wax, which is why they melt in hot sunshine!
